stages.name: preprocessing
stages.description: Pre-processing stage: Import movies, motion correction, CTF estimation, and micrograph selection

stages.name: particle_picking
stages.description: Particle picking stage: Detect and extract particles from micrographs

stages.name: optimization_2d
stages.description: 2D classification optimization stage: Iteratively refine particle selection using 2D classification and CryoSift

stages.name: heterogeneity
stages.description: Heterogeneity analysis stage: Determine true number of classes using ab initio + heterogeneous refinement and density comparison

stages.name: reconstruction
stages.description: 3D reconstruction stage: Generate initial models and refine 3D structures

stages.name: optimization
stages.description: Box size optimization stage: Optimize box size/diameter for 3D reconstruction

stages.name: polish
stages.description: Polish refinement stage: Final refinement steps with CTF refinement and motion correction to achieve best possible resolution
